claims.text: Nine Orchard occupies the restored and reimagined former Jarmulowsky Bank.

findings.quote: meticulously restored and reimagined the century-old Jarmulowsky Bank into an elegant hotel

claims.text: The Jarmulowsky Bank building was originally built in 1912.

findings.quote: Originally built in 1912, the former Jarmulowsky Bank has been lovingly restored

claims.text: The hotel is on the corner of Orchard and Canal Street on the Lower East Side.

findings.quote: Located on the corner of Orchard and Canal Street, the playground of the Lower East Side is at your fingertips.

claims.text: Rooms keep original Neo-Renaissance details, including original moldings, with large windows that fill the space with natural light.

findings.quote: Alive with original, Neo-Renaissance details and novel craftsmanship, our rooms offer guests
from original moldings and distinctive artisanship to large windows that fill the space with natural light

claims.text: Rooms feature commissioned artworks by local artists.

findings.quote: complemented by a collection of commissioned artworks from local artists

claims.text: Rooms are labeled like New York apartments, such as 2A or 4F, as an homage to city apartment living.

findings.quote: labeled as an homage to NYC apartment living–2A, 4F

claims.text: The Corner King rooms have curved corner windows.

findings.quote: The Corner King is 355 square feet, sleeps two in a King bed and features an antique custom desk, walk-in shower or tub, and curved corner windows.

claims.text: The Design Suite has sweeping Manhattan skyline views and an enhanced minibar with a Subzero fridge.

findings.quote: It also boasts sweeping views of the Manhattan skyline, has two televisions with Apple TV, and an enhanced minibar with Subzero fridge.

claims.text: The first floor has Corner Bar, an all-day restaurant inspired by classic taverns, and the Swan Room, a living room by day and cocktail lounge by night.

findings.quote: The first floor features two distinct culinary experiences: Corner Bar, our comfortable all-day restaurant inspired by classic taverns; and Swan Room, a grand living room-by-day and lavish cocktail lounge by night.

claims.text: The A, C and F trains are a one-minute walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: with the A, C, and F trains a one-minute walk from the hotel

claims.text: The hotel has three event spaces for gatherings small and large.

findings.quote: three event spaces are designed for gatherings both small and large

claims.text: The Swan Room sits in the former bank teller room, with its vaulted ceiling and pink Tennessee marble walls.

findings.quote: Found in the former bank teller room — with its vaulted ceiling, luxurious booths, and pink Tennessee marble walls

claims.text: Rooms have custom-made Ojas speakers programmed with New York-inspired stations curated by Devon Turnbull and DJ Stretch Armstrong.

findings.quote: custom-made Ojas speakers and amplifiers are programmed with four New York-inspired stations curated by Devon Turnbull and DJ Stretch Armstrong for our guests

claims.text: The Terrace Suite has a private terrace and sweeping city skyline views.

findings.quote: The Terrace Suite is 600 square feet, including a private 200 square foot terrace, sleeps two in a King bed and features a sitting area and sweeping city skyline views.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Terrace Suite has a private terrace with lounge chairs and a dining table.

findings.quote: with a 400 square foot private terrace that features lounge chairs and a dining table

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes that the city location comes with street noise, so light sleepers may want earplugs.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the overall vibe as chic, cool and largely for adults.

findings.quote: the overall vibe takes its cues from the neighborhood–chic, cool, and largely for adults
